en: Sunday, November 1, 12:51 p.m.
A business jet struck this neighborhood
in Palm Beach County, almost straight down.
All nine people on board were killed.
The Learjet 60 had left Austin, Texas, for the Bahamas,
cruising at 35,000 feet.
Over South Florida, it flew into a line of thunderstorms.
At 12:47, the crew reported turbulence and icing,
and asked to climb to 37,000 feet.
Moments later, the jet began to dive.
The pilots reported an overspeed,
a descent of 20,000 feet a minute, and called mayday.
In about one minute, it fell from 35,000 feet
to under 9,000.
It came down beside Military Trail.
About 600 residents were displaced.
Investigators see signs the jet may have begun
breaking apart before impact.
The cause is not yet known.
The NTSB hopes to recover the cockpit voice recorder.
